name: strip-shows-command
breaks: The shell status shows the command's first two words again, so shell syntax reaches the owner's strip.

name: flag-shown-twice
breaks: The watch forgets which flags it has shown, so the same note comes back after the owner dismissed it.

name: watch-never-backs-off
breaks: Typing past notes never backs the watch off, so every stop costs a look however often the owner ignores it.

name: stale-check-wins
breaks: An older check run's answer rewrites the newer card the owner is looking at.

name: stale-check-on-record
breaks: A check that lands after a newer press still writes its marks and its message into the record, so the newer card's message he sends is taken for his own words and the stale run moves conditions.

name: flag-replaces-card
breaks: A watch flag replaces the briefing card instead of waiting for the row.

name: stop-never-marked
breaks: A stop or a question never marks the row, so the owner is not told the session needs a look.

name: note-over-other-mod
breaks: The rep's note draws on top of another mod's note, putting two sets of digit buttons on screen.

name: digits-doubled
breaks: The row keeps its digit hotkeys while another mod draws, so one digit presses two buttons.

name: sessions-unbounded
breaks: The store keeps every session ever seen instead of the newest SESSIONS_MAX.

name: card-overflows-band
breaks: The briefing card is never folded to the band's rows, so a long card pushes its buttons out of the window where a digit cannot press them.

name: size-figure-dropped
breaks: The brief never gets the conversation's size from the engine, so the rep judges length by impression.

name: whole-ask-rule-dropped
breaks: The brief loses the rule that the owner's messages add up, so the rep judges the last message alone.

name: helper-not-counted
breaks: A helper the agent starts is never counted, so the status hides that helpers are running.

name: box-text-overwritten
breaks: The message is put into a prompt box that already has text in it, overwriting what the owner was typing.

name: fill-refusal-ignored
breaks: A prompt box that refuses the message is treated as having taken it, so the card closes and the owner is told it is there.

name: check-timeout-unreported
breaks: A check that outlasts its five minutes is stopped but reported as having failed to run, not as timed out.

name: check-failure-swallowed
breaks: A check whose run cannot start leaves the card saying it is still checking.

name: end-not-saved
breaks: The session end does not save the record, so a session that ends without a prompt loses its record's freshness.

name: row-shows-whole-reading
breaks: The row draws the whole objective (result, purpose, conditions and step) instead of the result alone, so the strip is crowded and the result is lost in it.

name: writer-forks-conversation
breaks: The objective writer's call is made as a fork of the agent's whole conversation instead of a plain completion over the owner's messages, so the writer reads everything the agent said, its account of the job included.
fixed: tested 2026-10-14 as agent-moves-reading; renamed and remade 2026-10-15; remade 2026-10-16

name: revision-cause-dropped
breaks: A correction keeps no cause, so the card cannot say which message of the owner's moved the objective.

name: note-reaches-agent
breaks: An Owner rep: prompt is passed through to the agent instead of being taken by the rep and dropped.

name: note-never-read
breaks: A note to the rep is recorded but starts no look, so the rep waits for the next stop to judge the work with it in mind.

name: earlier-job-leaks
breaks: A new job keeps the old job's first message as its start, so the writer and the briefing are shown a closed job's messages as if they were on this one.

name: tell-prefix-dropped
breaks: Tell the rep puts nothing in the prompt box, so what the owner types goes to the agent instead of the rep.

name: reading-state-unmarked
breaks: A press does not mark the rep as reading, so the row says nothing and a second press starts a second read.

name: checked-lists-never-fold
breaks: The checked lists are never folded to counts, so a small band loses whole parts of the card before the counts line it could have kept.

name: step-look-dropped
breaks: The look that fires every CHECK_EVERY model requests never fires, so a long turn gets no watch until it stops.

name: note-left-in-box
breaks: A note to the rep stays in the prompt box after it is taken, so the owner's next digit lands after it as text instead of pressing a button.

name: late-look-wins
breaks: The guard measures a write against the job's first message instead of the messages the held objective was built from, so a write that lands late takes a newer write's place.

name: revised-line-folds-first
breaks: The card folds the revision line away first, so on a band of ordinary height the owner never sees that the reading moved.

name: rows-counted-by-cells
breaks: Rows are counted by cells while the band wraps at words, so a long paragraph takes one row more than counted and a card believed to fit scrolls with its buttons out of a digit's reach.

name: holds-outlive-failures
breaks: The checked card's first fold drops the failed claims with the holding ones, so on an ordinary band the owner sees a count and never which claim was false.

name: well-with-left
breaks: The parser keeps the going-well line when the left-out list has items, so one card tells the owner every part is done and, three lines down, that something was not.

name: chore-to-owner
breaks: The briefs lose the rule that a chore the agent leaves for the owner is the agent's unfinished work, so the rep relays the agent's to-do list to him as his next step.

name: draft-as-his-words
breaks: A message the rep drafted and the owner sent is recorded in his list as his own words, unmarked, so the model grades the agent against a job the rep wrote and takes the rep's "nothing else" as the owner narrowing his job.

name: drafts-forgotten
breaks: Only the newest card's message is kept for knowing a draft, so a message he sends from an earlier card is recorded as his own words and can move the objective.

name: draft-weight-dropped
breaks: The briefs lose the weight for a message marked as the rep's draft, so the model reads one as the owner's words with full authority over what "done" means.

name: check-outside-copy
breaks: The check's run is started in the agent's own folder instead of the throwaway copy, so what the checker runs and writes lands in the folder the agent is working in.

name: refusals-unreported
breaks: The count of refused commands is always zero, so a check whose room has a hole looks clean on the card and the owner cannot see that the checker was stopped.

name: room-bypassed
breaks: The check's run bypasses approvals instead of running in the default mode with its tools allowed, which switches the built-in sandbox off (measured 15 Oct 2026), so the fence around the owner's work and the network is gone.

name: condition-dropped-uncited
breaks: A correction keeps only the conditions the writer wrote again, so a message that bounds the next step drops parts of what "done" means that the owner never let go.

name: stop-while-open
breaks: The gate never refuses, so a card can say stop, or that the work is going well, while a condition of the objective is still open or none is written.

name: unwritten-gate-open
breaks: With no objective written the gate lets everything through, so a card can tell the agent to stop, or say the work is going well, before anything measures it.

name: verdict-missing-continues
breaks: An answer with no verdict line, or one naming neither, is read as continue, so it passes the gate while a condition is open.

name: stop-next-unread
breaks: The gate reads only the verdict line, so an answer that says continue while its next step tells the agent to stop, or calls the work finished, passes while a condition is open.

name: draft-moves-result
breaks: The rep's own draft, sent by the owner, starts a rewrite and counts as a message of his, so the rep's words can change the result he asked for.

name: owner-cap-freezes
breaks: The record keeps only the newest 40 of the owner's messages, the job's included, so on a long job his first message, which says the most, drops out of what the writer and the briefing read.

name: old-reading-converted
breaks: A record saved before the objective keeps its old text as the result, with no conditions and no step, instead of being rebuilt from his messages, so the rep measures against a stale one-line text.

name: looks-write-objective
breaks: The watch takes an objective from its look at the conversation, so the agent's account of the job can rewrite the objective between the owner's message and the writer's answer.

name: marks-uncited
breaks: A look or a briefing can close a condition by citing any message number, a draft's included, so a condition the owner never let go is closed on the rep's or the agent's say.

name: mark-cites-built-message
breaks: A look, a briefing or a check can close a condition by citing a message the objective was already built from, one the writer read and kept the condition open after.

name: writer-cites-built-message
breaks: A correction can close or drop a condition by citing a message the held objective was already built from, so a later write reverses what the earlier one kept on the same words.

name: reopen-ignored
breaks: A check that finds a condition held shown is not so leaves it shown, so a stop passes the gate on a showing the check disproved.

name: shown-not-sent
breaks: The check is never told which conditions the rep holds shown, so it cannot test them again or reopen one.

name: well-beside-false
breaks: The checked card keeps the briefing's going-well line beside a claim the check found false or an item it left out.

name: conditions-pile-up
breaks: A condition the writer lists twice, or with a state mark copied into its text, is kept twice, so the list of what done means grows by repeats.

name: writer-failure-uncounted
breaks: A writer call that throws or comes back unanswered is not counted, so a session whose objective was never written looks on the price line as if nothing went wrong.

name: writer-failure-erases
breaks: A writer call that fails clears the objective already held, so one unreachable call leaves the job with nothing to measure the agent against.

name: writer-failure-unshown
breaks: The price line never names failed objective writes, whatever the count on record.

name: writer-failure-off-card
breaks: The briefing card's price line is built without the count of failed objective writes, so the owner is not told the objective was not written.

name: his-message-cut
breaks: The owner's own messages are cut to the drafts' 1,200 characters, so the asks at the end of a long first message never reach the writer.

name: prior-keeps-head
breaks: The agent's words before his message are kept from their start, so the question a short reply answers, usually at the end, is cut off.

name: writer-cap-cut
breaks: The objective writer's reply cap goes back to 1,200 tokens, under the 1,847 one measured write used, so every write is cut off or comes back empty and the objective is never written.

name: writer-unreadable-uncounted
breaks: A writer reply that arrives but cannot be read, as one cut off at its cap, is not counted as a failed write, so the objective never moves while the price line says nothing went wrong.

name: look-remarks-reopened
breaks: A look or a briefing that marks a condition the check reopened as shown moves it shown again, so the next stop passes the gate though the paid check found the claim false.

name: merge-raises-state
breaks: The writer's merge takes a proposed state over the held one by rank, so a correction can drop the check's reopened mark and its finding, and the merge alone would raise a condition to shown.

name: stop-filter-broad
breaks: The stop filter goes back to refusing any next step that holds the word stop or calls anything done, so a sound step such as stopping a wrong approach loses the model's own text for the rep's generic one and costs a second paid call.

name: writer-no-retry
breaks: The objective writer does not try a failed attempt again, so one empty reply leaves the session with no objective until the owner's next message.

name: holds-with-none-lost
breaks: A holds answer while no objective is held is taken as nothing, neither retried nor counted as a failed write, so the write is lost silently.

name: writer-retries-stale-prompt
breaks: A failed attempt is retried over the old prompt even after a newer message of the owner's arrived, so the retry spends a max-effort call on outdated messages and the write is counted failed.

name: writer-unfenced
breaks: His messages reach the objective writer without the fence and the note that they are records, so a message that reads like a command is taken as an order to the writer and comes back empty.

name: writer-no-system
breaks: The objective writer is sent no system prompt, so its rules never reach it.

name: writer-fence-closable
breaks: A fence tag typed in a message, or in the agent's words under it, is printed as it stands, so a message can close the fence and what follows reads as the writer's own instructions.

name: clear-id-read-once
breaks: The session id is read once per load of the module, so after a /clear his messages are filed under the session that ended and the new one never gets an objective.

name: clear-screen-kept
breaks: A /clear leaves the ended session's objective, card, note and last answer in place, so the new session's row shows the old job until something redraws it.

name: clear-late-write-draws
breaks: An objective write the ended session started lands after the /clear and draws its result on the new session's row.

name: clear-press-old-id
breaks: A press of Brief me after a /clear, before anything is typed or the module reads the id again, reads and records under the session that ended.

name: clear-brief-marks-draw
breaks: A briefing still running at a /clear marks a condition and draws the ended session's objective on the new session's row.

name: clear-check-marks-draw
breaks: A check still running at a /clear reopens a condition and draws the ended session's objective on the new session's row.

name: note-after-text-leaks
breaks: A note to the rep is found only at the start of the prompt, so one typed after other text in the box goes to the agent with the rest.

name: stop-wording-slips
breaks: A next step that says to wrap up and stop, to stop working on it, to stop and report, or that the session can end gets past the gate while a condition is open.

name: reopened-no-fallback
breaks: In a reopened session, or after /clear, where there is nothing to fork, the briefing says there is nothing to read yet and the watch reads nothing, though the session's record is there to read.

name: reopened-no-seed
breaks: A session the rep holds no record of (reopened after its record was dropped, forked with a new id, or older than the mod) keeps no message of his until he types again, so the card says the objective is not written yet.

name: seed-trusts-text
breaks: A row the engine wrote on his side that no prefix on NOT_TYPED names (another session's message, an idle notice, a scheduled task), and that the transcript does not hold as his, is seeded as a message of his, and the objective is written from words he never typed.

name: human-rows-unchecked
breaks: Lines of the session's transcript that the engine wrote, meta lines and lines with another origin or none, are read as messages he typed, so the seed takes words he never typed and the record read labels them his.

name: record-trusts-text
breaks: The record read in a reopened session labels a row the engine wrote as the person's whenever no prefix names it, though the transcript says otherwise, so the briefing reads the engine's words as his.

name: seed-no-folder-scan
breaks: A session forked with a new id, whose own transcript is not saved yet, has none of his messages read, so its objective is not written until he types again.

name: human-scan-uncapped
breaks: The scan of a forked session's folder reads every transcript in it, however many, before the press can go on.

name: human-scan-no-stop
breaks: The scan of a forked session's folder reads on after a file has matched every row that could be his, paying for reads that change nothing.

name: fork-draft-as-his
breaks: A card message he sent in the session this one was forked from is recorded as his own words, so the objective is written from the rep's draft.

name: command-form-raw
breaks: A slash command he ran is matched and recorded in the engine's saved tags rather than as he typed it, so a command with words after it is never proven his, and a bare one counts as a message.

name: seed-races-prompt
breaks: A prompt he sends while the session is still being read for his messages is recorded first, and the read then finds his message on record and seeds nothing, so every earlier message of his is lost to the objective.

name: seed-races-note
breaks: A note to the rep sent while the session is still being read for his messages is recorded first, and the read then seeds nothing, so the objective is written from the note alone.

name: glued-note-after-any
breaks: A prefix glued after a bracket, a dash, a quote or a backtick, as when he quotes the prefix to the agent, is split off as a note: the agent loses the rest of his prompt and the rep takes a mention for his words.

name: note-after-quote-missed
breaks: A note typed after a sentence that closes a quote or a bracket is not split off, so the agent reads the note meant for the rep.

name: note-split-in-command
breaks: A prefix inside a slash command's arguments is split off as a note, though the engine applies no rewrite to a command, so the rep records a note the agent still sees.

name: empty-note-silent
breaks: A prefix with nothing after it, behind a prompt, is taken out of the prompt without a word, so he believes the rep was told something.

name: and-stops-refused
breaks: AND_STOP refuses "stops" said of a program, so "Make sure the job runs once and stops." is taken as telling the agent to stop

name: end-after-condition-refused
breaks: END_SAID refuses an end after a condition and a comma, so "Once the run is green, the session can end." is taken as ending the job

name: end-after-so-passed
breaks: END_SAID lets an end joined by a comma and "so" or "and" through, so "The suite is green, so the session can end now." passes while a condition is open

name: wait-on-ci-refused
breaks: STOP_TO_REPORT refuses any "stop and wait", so waiting on the GitHub run or the CI run is taken as a stop

name: wait-on-him-passed
breaks: STOP_TO_REPORT no longer refuses a bare wait or one on him after a stop, so "stop and wait." passes while a condition is open.

name: step-look-reads-record
breaks: readSession falls back to the session record for every look, so each step look and stop look in a new session's first turn pays a full record read

name: note-look-skips-record
breaks: the look after his note never falls back to the session record, so a note in a reopened session reads nothing and moves no condition

name: press-skips-record
breaks: the press never falls back to the session record, so a briefing in a reopened session says there is nothing to read

name: record-numbers-as-messages
breaks: The session record labels its entries #N, the form his numbered messages take, so a record entry can be cited, and read by applyMarks, as one of his messages.

name: truncated-read-trusted
breaks: A read of the session's transcript cut at the output cap is taken as whole: his oldest messages are seeded alone, and his newest are labelled in the record as written by Claude Code.

name: scan-cut-read-trusted
breaks: In the scan of a forked session's folder, a file whose read was cut at the output cap is taken as read whole, so the part taken from it rests on a part of the file.

name: picture-data-kept
breaks: The read of a transcript keeps the data of every picture he pasted, so a few pictures push the read past the output cap and his newest messages are lost.

name: transcript-path-ignored
breaks: The transcript path Claude Code gives the session is never used: a forked session finds no file and seeds nothing, and every read starts with a search by name.

name: prompt-path-not-held
breaks: The transcript path a prompt carries is not held, so a session that never had a start hook of its own (or whose path changed) reads a file Claude Code no longer writes to.

name: find-fallback-missing
breaks: With no transcript path given, the session's file is never searched for by name, so a session reopened in place has none of his messages proven.

name: scan-unbounded
breaks: The scan of a forked session's folder runs on past its 30 seconds, reading file after file while his first prompt waits.

name: scan-timeout-fixed
breaks: Each read in the scan of a forked session's folder is allowed its full time even when less is left, so a slow disk holds his first prompt well past the scan's limit.

name: queued-message-unproven
breaks: A message he typed while the agent worked, saved as a queued command, is never read as his: the seed loses it, and a reopened session's record read labels it the session's.

name: queued-origin-unchecked
breaks: A queued task notification or another session's queued message is read as his because the queued command's origin is not checked.

name: queued-meta-taken
breaks: A queued command marked meta on its attachment is read as his.

name: wait-on-him-reply-passed
breaks: A wait on him with more words after it ("Stop and wait for him to reply.", "Stop and wait for his reply before going on.") passes the gate while a condition is open.

name: wait-on-him-words-narrow
breaks: A wait on his approval, his answer, his go-ahead, the owner's reply, a decision on something or confirmation from him passes the gate while a condition is open.

name: wait-until-passed
breaks: "Stop and wait until he replies." passes the gate while a condition is open.

name: ask-him-passed
breaks: "Stop and ask him what he wants." passes the gate while a condition is open.

name: stop-here-and-wait-passed
breaks: "Stop here and wait." passes the gate while a condition is open.

name: end-after-and-then-passed
breaks: "Fix the bug, and then the job can end." passes the gate while a condition is open.

name: clause-and-then-missed
breaks: A stop or a wrap-up after ", and then" ("Fix the bug, and then stop the agent.", "Fix the bug, and then wrap things up.") passes the gate while a condition is open.

name: fork-items-tail-kept
breaks: A fork with no file of its own yet takes every message in the parent's file after its last matched one, so what he sent the parent after the fork is seeded as the fork's.

name: fork-queued-tail-dropped
breaks: A fork with no file of its own yet loses the messages he typed while the agent answered his last message before the fork.

name: fork-items-rematch
breaks: A fork's row is matched to the same message of the other file as the row after it, so a message he sent once matches two rows that say it and the file looks a better match than it is.

name: fork-misses-counted
breaks: A fork's row that no message in a file holds counts as matched, so every file that matches anything looks like a full match and the scan can stop before the parent's file.

name: queued-prior-carried
breaks: A queued message, or one no row holds, is given the prior of the message before it, so the writer is told the agent had just said something it had not said when he typed it.

name: typed-cursor-stuck
breaks: A message sent twice is matched to the same row both times, so the earlier sending is given the agent's words from before the later one.

name: scan-first-match-taken
breaks: The scan of a forked session's folder takes the first file that matches any of the fork's rows, such as a sibling session sharing only his first message, instead of the file that matches the most.

name: scan-tie-takes-older
breaks: Of two files that match a fork's rows equally, the older is taken instead of the newer.

name: scan-unread-as-empty
breaks: A scan of a fork's folder that matched none of the fork's rows, because no file could be read whole or because the files read hold none of them, comes back as a read that found nothing of his, so the record read labels every one of his rows as written by Claude Code.

name: record-items-unused
breaks: The record read ignores the messages read from the transcript and labels rows by NOT_TYPED alone, so another session's message is shown as his words.

name: human-items-deduped
breaks: A message he sent twice is read from the transcript once, so the seed records it once.

name: human-items-not-typed-kept
breaks: A line marked his whose text NOT_TYPED names (a command's output, an interrupt mark, a compact summary) is read as a message he typed.

name: typed-forward-walk
breaks: His messages are matched to the rows from the start again, so after a compaction a short reply he sent before it takes the prior of its later sending, and the later one gets none.

name: fork-items-earliest-end
breaks: A fork's part of another session's messages ends at the earliest of equal matches, so a fork of a compacted parent drops every message he sent after the first sending of its short replies.

name: fork-items-gaps-ignored
breaks: A fork's part of another session's messages is chosen without counting his messages inside the matched span that the fork does not hold, so a parent that went on after the fork and repeated a message gives the fork the parent's later messages.

name: first-write-new-job-ignored
breaks: A session seeded from its transcript keeps every job it held as one: the first write's new job is ignored, so the earlier job's messages are shown to the writer and the briefing as this job's.

name: wait-your-any
breaks: A wait on anything after "your" counts as a wait on him, so "Stop and wait for your build to finish, then push." is refused while a condition is open.

name: wait-confirmation-any
breaks: A wait on anything that starts with "confirmation" counts as a wait on him, so "Stop and wait for confirmation emails to arrive in the test inbox, then check them." is refused while a condition is open.

name: wait-decision-any
breaks: A wait on anything that starts with "a decision" counts as a wait on him, so "Stop and wait for a decision tree to train, then evaluate it." is refused while a condition is open.

name: wait-on-him-unstopped-passed
breaks: A wait on him said without a stop ("Wait for his go-ahead.", "Wait for him to reply.", "Report and wait for him.") passes the gate while a condition is open.

name: hand-back-passed
breaks: "Hand it over to him." passes the gate while a condition is open.

name: check-in-passed
breaks: "Stop and check in with him." and "Stop and let him decide." pass the gate while a condition is open.

name: then-wait-passed
breaks: "Stop and report, then wait." passes the gate while a condition is open.

name: agent-ends-passed
breaks: "The agent can end the session." passes the gate while a condition is open.

name: stop-work-and-wait-passed
breaks: "Stop working and wait." passes the gate while a condition is open.

name: await-passed
breaks: "Stop and await his reply." passes the gate while a condition is open.

name: wait-negation-refused
breaks: A wait on him said not to happen ("Don't wait for his reply; push the fix.") is refused as a stop.

name: wait-negation-gap
breaks: A wait on him said not to happen with words between ("Don't just wait for him, run the suite.", "Do not stop and wait for him; run the suite.") is refused as a stop.

name: approval-from-anyone
breaks: A wait on approval from someone other than him ("Wait for approval from the CI gate, then merge.") is refused as a wait on him.

name: seed-drafts-held-ignored
breaks: A card message he sent that the forked-from record holds only among his messages as a draft (a card more than three back, or a record from an older build) is seeded as his own words.

name: dropped-drafts-lost
breaks: A record the store lets go takes its drafts with it, so a card message he sent in that session is seeded as his own words when the session is reopened or forked later.

name: dropped-drafts-unread
breaks: The drafts of records the store let go are kept but never read, so a card message he sent in such a session is seeded as his own words.

name: dropped-drafts-read-order
breaks: The drafts reader reads the kept list before the records, the order the store writes them, so a record let go between the two reads is in neither and a card message he sent there is seeded as his own words.

name: dropped-drafts-uncapped
breaks: The kept drafts of records let go grow without end.

name: dropped-drafts-oldest-first
breaks: A record's drafts held among his messages are taken oldest first, so the kept list's cap could keep an older draft over a newer one.

name: home-ignores-userprofile
breaks: On Windows, where HOME is unset, the home falls back to /tmp, so the transcripts and the check's copies are looked for in the wrong folder.

name: windows-commands-by-name
breaks: On Windows the coreutils are run by name, which finds nothing there, so the transcript reads fail.

name: windows-claude-by-name
breaks: On Windows the check would spawn the claude shim by name, which cannot be run without a shell.

name: candidates-unslashed
breaks: The folders tried for Git's coreutils keep their backslashes, so the path the probe proves is not the one later run.

name: plain-copy-nests
breaks: The plain copy puts the agent's folder inside the folder just made for it, so the check runs one level above the project.

name: copy-no-fallback
breaks: Where cp refuses -c, as GNU cp on Linux does, no copy is made and the check runs in the agent's own folder.

name: fallback-over-partial-clone
breaks: A Darwin clone that failed part-way on the files is copied again in full, into the part-made copy.

name: part-copy-left
breaks: A copy that failed part-way is left behind in the copies folder when the check falls back to the agent's folder.

name: windows-check-unfenced
breaks: On Windows, where Claude Code's sandbox is off, the check's run starts with nothing stopping it writing the owner's files or reaching the internet.

name: windows-find-by-name
breaks: On Windows the session's transcript is looked for with find by name, which finds nothing there, so none of his messages is read.

name: windows-read-by-name
breaks: On Windows the transcript is read with sed by name, which finds nothing there, so none of his messages is read.

name: windows-probe-failure-held
breaks: On Windows a probe for Git's commands that failed once, as one can the first time a virus scanner meets them, is held for the process, so none of his messages is read from a transcript again until Claude Code restarts.

name: windows-refusal-rests-on-probe
breaks: On Windows a lookup of the commands that throws makes the host look like a Unix one, so the check starts there with nothing fencing it.

name: home-tmp-is-none
breaks: A home that is /tmp is taken for no home, so the session's transcript is never looked for under /tmp/.claude.

name: windows-home-mixed-slashes
breaks: On Windows the home keeps the backslashes USERPROFILE gives it, so every path built from it mixes the two separators.

name: windows-held-path-backslashed
breaks: On Windows a transcript path Claude Code gives with backslashes is read as given, so a forked session's folder is never found and none of his messages is read.

name: windows-card-offers-check
breaks: On Windows the card shows the check's price, which says it starts a run in a throwaway copy, though the check does not run there.

name: windows-check-button-kept
breaks: On Windows the card offers Check it beside the note saying the check does not run there, a button that can only refuse.

name: fence-unavailable-runs
breaks: Where the sandbox cannot start (a Linux without bubblewrap, WSL1), the check's run warns and goes on with no fence instead of refusing to start.

name: fence-way-out-kept
breaks: The check's shell may ask to run a command outside the sandbox, the way Claude Code's own instructions tell a model to when the fence refuses, so a write the fence denied can be made anyway.

name: no-copy-brief-says-write
breaks: When no copy could be made and the check runs in the agent's own folder, its brief still tells it to write what it likes there and that the copy is removed after.
